reviewQuestions: Are deployer duties separated from provider duties?
Are monitoring and human oversight obligations complete?
scope: instructions for use, human oversight, monitoring and logs

preReviewFindings.finding: Provider and deployer duties share technical controls but must remain legally distinct.
preReviewFindings.requiredDecision: Approve role allocation and prevent cross-role completion claims.

preReviewFindings.finding: Monitoring, oversight and log-retention sufficiency depends on actual deployment and instructions.
preReviewFindings.requiredDecision: Define minimum workflow requirements and escalation triggers.

preReviewFindings.finding: Support, incident and customer-responsibility commitments are not fully established facts.
preReviewFindings.requiredDecision: Align legal package with approved commercial and operational commitments.

acceptanceCriteria: Deployer duties are not conflated with provider duties.
Instructions, oversight, monitoring, logs and escalation are covered.
National and employment-law dependencies are explicit.
humanInputsRequired: supported customer roles and use cases
limitations: The platform cannot prove real-world monitoring or human oversight effectiveness.
Employment and national public-law requirements require local advice.
Customer instructions and system facts remain external evidence.
